operations.recovery: Follow OPERATIONS.md: pause writes and retain the exact source, private settings and original ENVELOPE_RECORD_KEY. Export with rer export, restore into fresh empty resources with rer import and the original record key, re-export and compare supported records before routing traffic. Establish the native owner after restore and preserve every applied migration name and byte.
